in_marathi.name: Budhiram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom (Budhi) Rama (God Rama)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Budhiram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Budhi: Wisdom, intellect, and intelligence. Rama: An incarnation of Lord Vishnu, known for his virtues, courage, and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Budhiram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wisdom (Budhi) Rama (God Rama)
